t.E961.agn: In 2025 EFSA raised the acceptable daily intake (ADI) from 2 to 10 mg/kg body weight and reported that estimated intake did not exceed this limit. It stated that the amount of phenylalanine that may form during its breakdown would, even at this limit, increase the phenylalanine level in the blood by less than 1%, and that it is safe for the general population, including carriers.
t.E961.body: It is rapidly absorbed and largely broken down before passing into the body; its breakdown products are excreted in the urine.
t.E961.prod: A sweetener produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E961.regx.0: Re-evaluated; ADI raised from 2 to 10 mg/kg.
t.E961.summary: A synthetic sweetener similar to aspartame but much sweeter. Used in very small amounts.
t.E961.what: An intense sweetener produced chemically from aspartame and used in very small amounts.
